name: Men men
summary: Mèn mén is the corn dish the ethnic desk gives to the Mong. The page does not describe the method. In Sa Pa, how it is served is check on arrival.
origin: The ethnic-tourism page says the Mong make mèn mén from corn. It does not place the dish on a Sa Pa street.
howToEat: The method is not on the page. Check on arrival.
where: A Sa Pa street was not named. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Men men in Sapa — Mong corn, method on arrival
seoDescription: Mèn mén is the Mong corn dish on the northwest food page. A Sa Pa method and a stall were not printed. Check on arrival.
